stem: A learner calls every junction on a cannabis shoot a meristem. What correction best improves the record?
choices: Distinguish nodes, internodes, apical meristems, and axillary growth points because they are related but not interchangeable structures
Use 'meristem' for every visible plant part to simplify records
Replace all anatomy terms with the cultivar name
Record only plant height because location terminology is unnecessary
rationale: Precise anatomical language is necessary for reproducible observations and later cultivation decisions. Nodes and meristems are related structural concepts but are not synonyms.
